_comment: THE SETTLEMENT STAGE LADDER (#176). A settlement is a tribe, or a lone band in none; each turn it resolves to the highest row whose criteria ALL hold. min_size is head-count summed over the settlement's bands; min_store_rung is the highest food_stores rung any member's owned store holds (compared by the ladder's order); min_food is food stored across the members' larders and owned fixed stores; min_belief is belief on the settlement's anchor tile. `announce` rows are told on the command feed the first turn a settlement newly reaches them. `pull_from_stage` is the row from which a tribe pulls nearby bands (leadership_config tribe_weight_settlement). EVERY THRESHOLD IS AN OPENING VALUE AND A PLAYTEST DIAL: town 300 + a pit; city 1000 + a granary + 1500 food (three-quarters of one granary's 2000, so it must be kept stocked) + 30 belief (a place of real dead, about 1.5x the tether's 20-dead reference).
